description: Fail-closed exact executable evidence contract for every delivered Oteryn portal surface that consumes long localized content or bounded large collections. It proves only mapped synthetic acceptance boundaries and does not close unrelated Issue #326 states or production verification.

identity.registration-login-session.rationale: Bounded authentication forms and status messages; no user-managed long body or collection route is declared.

identity.password-lifecycle.rationale: Bounded password forms and recovery status messages; no long body or collection route is declared.

identity.mfa-lifecycle.rationale: Bounded MFA forms, QR provisioning and recovery-code state; no long body or paginated collection route is declared.

account.overview-provisioning.rationale: Bounded account binding and provisioning status surface.

player-companion.session-analysis.rationale: Session input is capped at 65,535 bytes, persisted history is capped at 50 records, participants are capped at 20 and metric tables use bounded responsive overflow containers.

account.character-creation-and-visibilit.rationale: Bounded character creation form and visibility outcome; public collection consumers are owned by public.game-data.

public.home-and-seo.rationale: Homepage renders localized managed news and active announcements whose titles and bodies can reach editorial limits.

public.news-and-managed-pages.rationale: Public news and managed-page index/detail routes render localized editorial titles and bodies.

public.game-data.rationale: Highscores and related public game-data routes expose bounded pagination and long externally sourced values.

admin.core-rbac-cms-audit.rationale: Administrator CMS indexes render bounded collections and long editorial values inside table and form layouts.

public.localization-core.rationale: Polish translation editors render long English source values and long localized form values.

downloads.public-admin-localization.rationale: Download Center renders localized release notes and artifact metadata, while its administrator index is paginated.

events.public-admin.rationale: Public event cards/details render localized descriptions, while the administrator event index is paginated.

announcements.admin-localization-home-co.rationale: Localized announcements render on the homepage and in a paginated administrator index.

support-legal.public-admin-localization.rationale: Support and legal pages render versioned localized managed document titles and bodies.

wiki.public.rationale: Public Wiki articles render long localized Markdown and search results use bounded pagination.

wiki.admin-editorial-lifecycle.rationale: Wiki administration renders long editorial values and paginated article indexes.

editorial-media.admin.rationale: Editorial Media renders a paginated administrator table with bounded long metadata and verified private thumbnails.

browser-supporting-media-preview-endpoin.rationale: Resource endpoints do not independently render document layout; evidence belongs to their rendered consumers.

game-catalog.public-items-creatures-and-.rationale: Catalog list pages are server-paginated at 24 records and catalog fields are schema-bounded; the fragment declares no independently managed long-content scale boundary.

game-catalog.administrator-inspection.rationale: Read-only administrator inspection queries are hard-capped between 50 and 200 rows and expose bounded catalog metadata rather than an independently paginated scale surface.

identity.account-security-lifecycle.rationale: Security forms are bounded and the active web-session registry is hard-capped at 50 records, so this fragment declares no independent content-scale consumer.

identity.character-profile-preferences.rationale: Profile preferences are one bounded record and the free-text comment is limited to 500 characters; no collection or long managed body is rendered.

marketplace.admin-wallet-and-recovery.rationale: Administrator wallet history and recovery queues are hard-capped at 50 and 100 records and adjustment text is bounded, with no independent scale contract.

marketplace.authenticated-auction-lifecy.rationale: Authenticated watched, bid, selling and history collections are each hard-capped at 100 records and lifecycle forms use bounded fields rather than managed long content.

marketplace.public-catalogue-and-detail.rationale: Public auction catalogue pages are server-paginated at 24 records and public bid history is configuration-capped, with no independently managed long-content scale boundary.

payments.account-history-and-return.rationale: Authenticated payment history is server-paginated at 20 records and renders bounded identifiers, integer-minor-unit amounts and finite state labels rather than long managed content.

payments.admin-reconciliation.rationale: The privileged reconciliation queue is hard-capped at 100 rows and exposes bounded codes and identifiers; it has no independent long-content or unbounded collection contract.

payments.test-provider-ingress.rationale: The deterministic non-production provider ingress is a bounded JSON transport endpoint and does not render document layout.

public.community-deaths-and-policy.rationale: Deaths are a bounded 50-row public pagination projection of the existing public game-data domain; independent scale ownership remains with public.game-data.

support.moderation-lifecycle.rationale: Ticket and moderation indexes use bounded 20- or 30-row pagination while detail forms and messages are governed by dedicated support acceptance rather than this managed-content scale contract.

public-content.marker: @portal-content-scale long bilingual news and managed pages wrap and remain contained

admin-content.marker: @portal-content-scale-admin long CMS localization and bounded administrator pagination remain contained

events.marker: @portal-content-scale-events long bilingual event content and bounded administrator pagination remain contained

wiki.marker: @portal-content-scale-wiki long bilingual articles stable multi-page search and administrator pagination remain contained

media.marker: @portal-content-scale-media bounded Editorial Media pagination and table containment use valid private bytes

game-data.marker: @portal-community-stress long values multi-page results internal 500 containment and recovery

nonclaims: The bounded synthetic fixtures are not an unbounded load or performance test.
The mapped browser evidence does not prove every unrelated state permutation owned by parent Issue #326.
No staging, production, Canary, schema, payment-provider or user-data behavior is proven or mutated.
